subject: geography
title: Rabi, Kharif & Zaid Crops
description: Three cropping seasons in India with major crops

content.overview: India has three main cropping seasons: Rabi (winter), Kharif (monsoon), and Zaid (summer).
keyPoints: Rabi Crops (Oct-Dec to Mar-Apr): Wheat, Barley, Gram, Peas, Mustard, Linseed, Sunflower, Potato, Onion, Garlic, Coriander
Kharif Crops (Jun-Jul to Sep-Oct): Rice, Maize, Jowar, Bajra, Cotton, Groundnut, Soybean, Tur, Urad, Moong, Sesame, Castor
Zaid Crops (Mar-Jun): Watermelon, Muskmelon, Cucumber, Bitter gourd, Pumpkin, Bottle gourd, Sponge gourd, Ridge gourd
Cash Crops: Cotton, Jute, Sugarcane, Tobacco, Tea, Coffee, Rubber, Spices
Food Crops: Rice, Wheat, Maize, Pulses, Millets
Plantation Crops: Tea, Coffee, Rubber, Coconut, Areca nut
Horticulture: Fruits (Mango, Banana, Apple, Citrus), Vegetables, Flowers, Spices

mnemonics.trick: W-B-G-P-M-L = Wheat, Barley, Gram, Peas, Mustard, Linseed
mnemonics.explanation: Rabi crops: Wheat, Barley, Gram, Peas, Mustard, Linseed

mnemonics.trick: R-M-J-B-C-G-S = Rice, Maize, Jowar, Bajra, Cotton, Groundnut, Soybean
mnemonics.explanation: Kharif crops: Rice, Maize, Jowar, Bajra, Cotton, Groundnut, Soybean

quiz.question: Which is a Rabi crop?
quiz.explanation: Wheat is a Rabi crop (winter season)

quiz.question: Which is a Kharif crop?
quiz.explanation: Rice is a Kharif crop (monsoon season)

quiz.question: Zaid crops are grown in which season?
quiz.explanation: Zaid crops are grown in summer (March-June)
